_comment: Expected post-PO state for the feat-todo fixture. Asserted by runner.mjs --verify-po. Schema: each top-level key describes one assertion the runner checks; the runner prints PASS/FAIL per key.

specDirectoryExists._description: After PLAN, the spec-driven mode directory must exist with stories/ and tasks/ subdirs populated.

specBodyValid._description: The spec body file is unchanged from the fixture (PO phase doesn't rewrite it).

exactlyOneStory._description: specification-agent should produce exactly 1 US for this fixture (1 functional requirement, no UI).

exactlyOneTask._description: Per protocol R2: 1 task per US when no PNG. The single task must be Type=Tech (no UI in this fixture).

noUITask._description: Anti-assertion: there must NOT be any task with Type=UI (no PNG in fixture, designer-agent skipped, frontend-agent should not be invoked).

noDesignSpec._description: Anti-assertion: no PNGs → no design-spec.md should be generated.

noErrorReportYet._description: PO phase doesn't run the correction loop; no error-report.md should exist after PLAN.

noShipMarkerYet._description: Anti-assertion: PLAN must NOT write the .pipeline-shipped marker (R1: PLAN/SHIP separation).
